content.text: I'll investigate the September spend spike for bc-t0007 by checking the margin data.

input.sql:
SELECT 
  margin_date,
  tenant_id,
  ai_revenue_usd,
  llm_cost_usd,
  cost_to_serve_usd,
  gross_margin_usd,
  gross_margin_pct,
  request_count
FROM fct_tenant_margin
WHERE tenant_id = 'bc-t0007'
  AND CAST(date_trunc('month', margin_date) AS DATE) >= '2024-09-01'
ORDER BY margin_date DESC
LIMIT 200
